# RemodelerIQ

> AI-Powered Contractor Bid Analysis for Homeowners

RemodelerIQ is a free tool that helps homeowners analyze contractor estimates and bids before signing. Upload a PDF, image, or paste text from any contractor proposal to get instant analysis including price comparison, scope review, contractor verification, and negotiation guidance. Built by Gustavo to protect homeowners from overpaying — what started as a personal spreadsheet during his own renovation became a tool used by thousands.

**Last updated: 2026-06-21**

## The Three Pillars Methodology

Every contractor bid analyzed by RemodelerIQ is scored against three weighted pillars:

1. **Contract Risk (40%)** — payment terms, missing legal protections, deposit red flags, allowance traps
2. **Price Check (30%)** — line items compared to live BLS labor wages, FRED material price indices, and Zonda 2026 cost benchmarks for the specific ZIP code
3. **Scope Completeness (30%)** — vague language, change-order traps, missing brand/model specifications

Combined score determines whether a bid is HIGH / FAIR / LOW by what percentage. The methodology is explained at [how-we-score](https://remodeleriq.com/how-we-score).

## What RemodelerIQ Does

RemodelerIQ reads contractor bids and estimates, then provides:

- **Price Analysis**: Compares bid pricing to live 2026 market data from Bureau of Labor Statistics OEWS, FRED Producer Price Indices, Zonda Cost vs Value 2026, and Houzz 2024 cost guides
- **Scope Review**: Identifies missing items, vague language, and potential gaps in the proposal
- **Contractor Verification**: Checks business reputation via Google Reviews, BBB, and state licensing databases (the Trusted Radar tool)
- **Negotiation Guidance**: Provides data-backed talking points for discussing pricing with contractors
- **Risk Flags**: Highlights concerning payment terms, missing insurance, unlicensed work, and red flags

## Data Sources

RemodelerIQ analysis is powered by:

- [Zonda Cost vs Value 2026](https://www.remodeling.hw.net/cost-vs-value): National remodeling cost benchmarks for 30+ project types across all US regions, updated annually
- [BLS Occupational Employment & Wage Statistics (OEWS)](https://www.bls.gov/oes/): Real hourly wage data for construction trades by metro area, updated annually
- [FRED Producer Price Indices](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/): Live material price index tracking for construction commodities (lumber, plumbing fixtures, electrical, drywall, tile)
- [Houzz 2024 Cost Guides](https://www.houzz.com/): Project cost ranges and labor percentages (transitioning to 2026 data when published)
- [Google Places API](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/places/): Business ratings and reviews
- State contractor licensing databases

## MCP Server (for AI agents)

RemodelerIQ runs a Model Context Protocol server so AI agents can USE the analyzer on a user's behalf (not just read about it). Streamable-HTTP endpoint: `https://remodeleriq.com/mcp`. Discovery: [/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json](https://remodeleriq.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json).

Tools:
- `analyze_bid` — score a contractor's remodeling bid for fairness; returns confidence score, red flags, missing items, negotiation talk-track. Inputs: bid_text, bid_total?, state_code?.
- `get_cost_estimate` — 2026 cost range for a project in a US state/city (Zonda-backed). Inputs: project_type, state_code, city_key?.
- `get_labor_rates` — BLS construction trade labor rates by US state. Inputs: state_code, trade?.

## Regional Cost Guides

936 city-and-project remodeling cost guides — 52 metros × 18 project types — each with local BLS labor data, FRED material indices, regional cost factors, permit timelines, state-specific gotchas, and an FAQ section (FAQPage schema). Index at [/remodeling-cost-guides/](https://remodeleriq.com/remodeling-cost-guides/).

**URL pattern:** `/remodeling-cost-guides/{city}-remodeling-cost-guide/{project}/` — e.g. [Austin roof replacement cost](https://remodeleriq.com/remodeling-cost-guides/austin-tx-remodeling-cost-guide/roof-replacement/), [Atlanta kitchen remodel cost](https://remodeleriq.com/remodeling-cost-guides/atlanta-ga-remodeling-cost-guide/kitchen-remodel/).

**18 project types covered per metro:** kitchen remodel, bathroom remodel, basement remodel, home addition, roof replacement, siding replacement, flooring, deck, whole-house remodel, garage build, sunroom, interior painting, exterior painting, window replacement, HVAC replacement, ADU / garage conversion, driveway replacement, fence installation.

Sample cities:

- [Atlanta, GA](https://remodeleriq.com/remodeling-cost-guides/atlanta-ga-remodeling-cost-guide/)
- [Phoenix, AZ](https://remodeleriq.com/remodeling-cost-guides/phoenix-az-remodeling-cost-guide/)
- [Dallas, TX](https://remodeleriq.com/remodeling-cost-guides/dallas-tx-remodeling-cost-guide/)
- [Chicago, IL](https://remodeleriq.com/remodeling-cost-guides/chicago-il-remodeling-cost-guide/)
- [Charlotte, NC](https://remodeleriq.com/remodeling-cost-guides/charlotte-nc-remodeling-cost-guide/)
- [Seattle, WA](https://remodeleriq.com/remodeling-cost-guides/seattle-wa-remodeling-cost-guide/)

Each city guide includes: 2026 cost data by project type, regional cost factor vs national baseline, local labor wages by trade, permit timelines and costs, state-specific gotchas, and FAQ section.

## Project Types Supported

RemodelerIQ can analyze bids for:

### Kitchen & Bath
- Kitchen remodel (minor, major midrange, major upscale)
- Bathroom remodel and bathroom additions
- Cabinet refinishing, refacing, and replacement
- Countertop installation (granite, quartz, laminate)

### Exterior
- Roofing (asphalt, metal, standing seam)
- Roof repair and insurance claims
- Siding (vinyl, fiber-cement, wood)
- Windows and doors (entry, patio, French, garage)
- Deck construction and repair (wood, composite)
- Paver patios

### Interior
- Flooring (hardwood, laminate, carpet, tile)
- Painting (interior, exterior, cabinet refinishing)
- Basement finishing and refinishing
- Electrical and plumbing work

### Additions & Major Projects
- Home additions and ADUs
- Primary suite additions
- HVAC systems and generators
- Solar panel installation

## How to Use

1. **Upload or paste** your contractor bid (PDF, image, or text)
2. **Enter project details** (square footage, ZIP code)
3. **Get instant analysis** with price comparison, risk flags, and scope review
4. **Use insights** to negotiate or validate your contractor's pricing
